rationale: Separate training-schedule effects from author fusion effects before trying another attention family.

evidence.threshold_scope: validation only,0.30 to0.70 step0.05; CCA optimum at upper boundary, not a global threshold optimum
evidence.interpretation: Loss divergence consistent with overfitting/confidence changes, not proof of cause. Connected false positives include both small boundary extensions and distant connected oversegmentation.

next_experiment.intervention: Change only lr_epoch cosine denominator300 to100 in BOTH new arms. Same pretrained encoder, copied initialization, input256, data order, common loss, optimizer, split, selection, native author modules.
next_experiment.evaluation: val macro Dice chooses checkpoint; paired val effects and FP/FN/boundary diagnostics; every locked checkpoint evaluated on all867 test images; no test-based model/threshold selection.
next_experiment.success_policy: If schedule helps both, attribute gain to training, not CCA. Advance CCA only with validation advantage vs same-schedule baseline that warrants confirmation with another matched seed. If no advantage, stop this CCA adaptation.
next_experiment.limitations: Existing test exposed repeatedly; not an independent final confirmation; new independent/deduplicated data required for strong final claims.

deferred.MADGNet: Original and FP32 upblock did not meet current reproducibility preflight; do not interpret as negative segmentation result. No formal training scheduled.
